title: PNP seizes P37.1M in smuggled cigarettes in Mimaropa

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police operations against cigarette smuggling in Palawan and Puerto Princesa City led to the arrest of 47 people and the confiscation of cigarette products and other items worth an estimated P37.16 million from January to September this year, police said. The Mimaropa police conducted 31 operations from Jan. 1 to Sept. 30, according to accomplishment reports from the Palawan Police Provincial Office (PPO) and the Puerto Princesa City Police Office (PPCPO).
